title: LADA Blue Wings vs Ugly Pucklings, Sep 27
notes: Away game at Renton: we wore blue and had the left bench (the pipeline's defaults). First game processed on the Windows PC (RTX 5090).

Periods, goals and shots come from the arena scoreboard (we were GUEST): periods 0:15-18:16, 19:54-38:31 and 39:58-64:47 of the video, by the clock. The clock stopped at whistles in the 3rd, so it ran 24:49 of video. The video runs to the final horn.

Goals at 15:37, 28:36, 36:18 and 50:26 of the video (ours; clock 2:35 1st, 9:15 and ~1:30 2nd, 9:06 3rd) and 56:13 and 62:52 (Ugly Pucklings; clock 5:17 and 0:43 3rd), matching the goal times from the team. Shots on goal: Blue Wings 15, Ugly Pucklings 31. No penalties: neither penalty panel lit up.

Played: the 10 skaters of LADA's lineup, with sub Bronnikov #74. Didn't play: Skitsko #16, Babkin #26, Trunov #35, Charnysh #36, Dukhno #50, Horokh #77, Shipachev #88, Antonov #95. Ugly Pucklings' white #95 (Kloppmann) passed our jersey test and was read as our #95, so #95 was left out of the roster for the solve.

Labeled by hand: P1 rows R152 and R154 (Ilinskaya #3 stayed on for the first goal) and P3 row R185 (Zhuk #2, number visible at 60:53). Two short gaps remain: P1 17:11-17:28 (Tverskoy #44 stood by our bench at a stoppage, so the solver took him off) and P3 63:39-63:58, both 4 on the ice for under 20 s.
